title: 第11章 学新道术直接拉满第12章 紫霄神雷大圆满恐怖雷法
slug: 九叔系统道术给我全加满
content_zh:
“快退！”
九叔流转一道气息，横挡在前方！
众人惊呼间连连倒退。
只见那黑气在九叔的气息中，滋滋腐蚀着。
没几秒便被气息消融，化为烟雾，随风消散。
九叔与林凡，对视一眼，心照不宣。
那棺材内的任太爷，尸体经二十年不腐，浑身散发黑气。
师徒二人明显已然察觉棺内异象。
任太爷成僵尸了！
而且还不止是最低级的黑僵！
明显已有突破成为紫僵的兆头！
“爹！”
“爷爷！”
任婷婷，与任老爷齐刷刷的向棺木跪下。
“惊动了你老人家，孩儿真是不孝。”
“九叔，这墓穴还能用吗？”
任老爷哭丧着脸，扭头看向九叔。
九叔摇头道：“蜻蜓点水，一点再点，肯定不会点在同一个地方了，这个穴没用了。”
“那怎么办？”
“我提议就地火化”

九叔面色严肃道。
“火化，不行！先父生前最怕的就是火。我不能这样做。”
任老爷委屈巴巴的回道。
“任老爷，不火化会有麻烦。”
“怎么都行，就是不能火化，你想想其他办法吧。”
九叔见状，无奈道：“好吧，那就只能暂时寄存在我们义庄了。到明天，我会帮任老太爷另外找一处墓穴。”
“好，盖上棺材盖，抬到义庄”
只见任婷婷的表哥阿威指挥着工人呼道。
“那任老爷你们先回吧。”
九叔抬手示意道。
随即任家众人便坐上人工抬轿，往任家返程。
众人离去之际，九叔吩咐道：“文才，秋生。你们两就在墓穴点个梅花香阵，烧成什么样回来告诉我。”
临走之时，还不忘交代两人每个坟头都得上香。
“就知道使唤我俩，大师兄倒是拍拍屁股走人了。”
文才望着九叔和林凡离去的背影，抱怨道。
“行了，别废话，天快黑了，赶紧干事。”
秋生呵斥一声，旋即抓起一把香，往附近的坟地去。
忽见一墓碑上，有漂亮女子画像。
“二十岁就死了，真的可惜。”
看着眼前名为董小玉的墓碑，秋生不禁感叹一声。
content_en:
"Quickly retreat!"
Uncle Jiu circulated a breath and blocked the front!
Everyone screamed and fell back again and again.
I saw the black energy corroding in Uncle Jiu's breath.
Within seconds, it was melted by the breath, turned into smoke, and dissipated in the wind.
Uncle Jiu and Lin Fan looked at each other, understanding each other tacitly.
The body of Mr. Ren in the coffin had not decayed for twenty years and was exuding black energy.
The two masters and apprentices had obviously noticed something strange inside the coffin.
Mr. Ren has become a zombie!
And it’s not just the lowest level of black zombies!
It is obviously a sign that it has broken through and become purple stiffness!
"Dad!"
"Grandpa!"
Ren Tingting and Master Ren both knelt down towards the coffin.
"I alarmed your old man. The child is really unfilial."
"Uncle Jiu, can this tomb still be used?"
Master Ren turned to look at Uncle Jiu with a sad face.
Uncle Jiu shook his head and said: "If the dragonfly touches the water, a little bit more, it will definitely not hit the same place. This point is useless."
"What should we do?"
"I propose to be cremated on the spot"
Uncle Jiu said with a serious face.
"Cremation, no! What my father was most afraid of when he was alive was fire. I can't do that."
Master Ren replied aggrievedly.
"Master Ren, there will be trouble if we don't cremate him."
"Anything is fine, but it can't be cremated. You can think of other ways."
Seeing this, Uncle Jiu said helplessly: "Okay, then we can only store it in our Yizhuang temporarily. Tomorrow, I will help Mr. Ren find another tomb."
"Okay, close the coffin lid and carry it to Yizhuang."
I saw Ren Tingting's cousin Ah Wei directing the workers to shout.
"Master Ren, please go back first."
Uncle Jiu raised his hand to indicate.
Immediately, everyone in the Ren family got on the manual sedan and headed back to the Ren family.
When everyone was leaving, Uncle Jiu ordered: "Wen Cai, Qiu Sheng. You two will light a plum blossom incense array in the tomb, and tell me how you burn it."
Before leaving, he did not forget to tell the two of them that incense must be placed on every grave.
"You know how to order us around, but the senior brother just patted his ass and left."
Wen Cai looked at Uncle Jiu and Lin Fan's leaving figures and complained.
"Okay, don't talk nonsense. It's getting dark soon. Let's get to work quickly."
Qiu Sheng scolded, then grabbed a handful of incense and went to the nearby cemetery.
Suddenly I saw a portrait of a beautiful woman on a tombstone.
"It's such a pity to die at the age of twenty."
Looking at the tombstone named Dong Xiaoyu in front of him, Qiu Sheng couldn't help but sigh.
